title: Detect a repeated value
prompt: Return true if an integer appears at least twice in nums. Return false for an empty array.

title: Best single stock trade
prompt: Given prices by day, buy once and sell on a later day for the largest profit. Return 0 if no profitable trade exists.

title: Products except index
prompt: Return an array where each position holds the product of every other number. Do not use division. Aim for linear time.

title: Count target sum subarrays
prompt: Count contiguous subarrays whose sum equals target. Values may be negative. Aim for linear time.

title: Check anagrams
prompt: Return true when two lowercase strings contain the same characters with the same frequencies. Empty strings are anagrams.

title: Longest distinct character span
prompt: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring without a repeated character. Treat characters as JavaScript string units.

title: Merge overlapping intervals
prompt: Given [start,end] intervals, merge overlapping intervals and return them ordered by start. Intervals touching at an endpoint also merge.

title: Read a matrix in a spiral
prompt: Return matrix values clockwise from the outside inward. The matrix is rectangular; return an empty array for empty input.

title: Pair sum in sorted numbers
prompt: Given ascending numbers and a target, return the zero-based indices of one matching pair, smaller index first. Return [-1,-1] when none exists.

title: Widest water container
prompt: Each height is a vertical line. Choose two lines that hold the maximum area of water. Return 0 for fewer than two lines.

title: Longest ones after flips
prompt: Given a binary array, return the longest contiguous run of 1s possible after flipping at most k zeros.

title: Count staircase routes
prompt: Count distinct ways to reach step n when each move is one or two steps. Step 0 has one empty route. Assume 0 <= n <= 40.

title: Fewest coins for an amount
prompt: Given positive coin denominations and an amount, return the fewest coins needed, or -1 when impossible. Coins may be reused.

title: Maximum nonadjacent loot
prompt: Choose nonadjacent values for the largest total. Values are non-negative; choosing nothing yields 0.

title: Validate bracket nesting
prompt: Return true if a string of (), [], and {} brackets is correctly nested and closed. An empty string is valid.

title: Days until a warmer temperature
prompt: For each daily temperature, return how many days until a strictly warmer day, or 0 if none follows.

title: Find sorted insertion position
prompt: Return the first index where target could be inserted in ascending nums while preserving order. Duplicates insert before existing equal values.

title: Search a rotated sorted array
prompt: An ascending array of distinct numbers was rotated at an unknown pivot. Return target's index, or -1 when absent. Aim for logarithmic time.

title: Count land islands
prompt: Count connected groups of '1' cells in a grid of '0' and '1'. Cells connect vertically or horizontally. The grid is rectangular.

title: Can all courses be finished?
prompt: There are n courses numbered 0..n-1. Each [course, prerequisite] pair means the prerequisite must come first. Return false when dependencies contain a cycle.
